scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic identities and a complete analytic sign argument establish the all-step classification; deterministic numerical experiments corroborate but cannot replace proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to symmetric four-vertex stars with strictly positive conductances and the exact [2/2] Padé end-step.
Does not classify internal Runge–Kutta stages, floating point behavior or larger graphs.
Specialized historical literature may contain comparable results.
title: A complete positivity frontier for fourth-order Padé stepping on weighted three-spoke stars
